purpose: T07 tracking through a native C++ driver on ACTS 48.2.0, and the fixture generators t07-telescope-clean/1, t07-telescope-noise/1 and t07-telescope-cai/1 on the same geometry; this version holds the telescope geometry, the driver's own product format and the refit of a known hit set at zero field or the fixture's 1 T, which is truth-assisted and never finding and writes R33's track-fit outputs (residuals by state, unbiased residuals, alignment derivatives, incidence and path) with a check program for CAI-T07-2, and refits with a supplied alignment payload (t07-alignment-payload/1 by --alignment-payload, role alignment conditions, recorded in the product's alignment_payload header line, refused against another nominal geometry) for CAI-T07-3, and pattern recognition on hits alone, seeds, CKF and ambiguity resolution, in a program of its own, which writes acts-tracking-product/1, or acts-tracking-product/2 with R33's outputs of its delivered tracks when asked by --r33-outputs t07-r33/1, with an optional vertex step on its delivered tracks through ACTS's adaptive multi-vertex finder, beside a scoring-side program for the truth-seeded comparator that shares its steps after the start and is never finding; the thin wrapper assets/acts_tracking.py forwards --alignment-payload on refit and --r33-outputs on find, each only when given, and leaves reading them to the programs; optional, required by no skill
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; development jobs have built and run the driver, and it stays proposed until such a run is recorded in VALIDATION.md with its environment and tested version; no tracking quality claim for a real detector
